name: Drew Wrigley
desc: 37th Lieutenant Governor of North Dakota; former U.S. Attorney for the District of North Dakota
summary: Drew Howard Wrigley (born October 10, 1965) is an American lawyer and politician serving as the attorney general of North Dakota since 2022. Wrigley, already running for the office, was appointed by Governor Doug Burgum when incumbent Wayne Stenehjem died unexpectedly. Wrigley was elected to a full four-year term in November 2022, garnering 71% of the vote.
